newsitem.title: USA: Earthgrains sets two-for-one stock split.
newsitem.headline: Earthgrains sets two-for-one stock split.

text.p: Earthgrains Co said Monday its board of directors declared a two-for-one stock split for shareholders of record as of May 30.
The split will be effective July 28.
Earthgrains said the split recognizes its significant stock price appreciation since the company was spun off on March 27, 1996.
Earthgrains' stock closed Friday at 59-1/4, near its 52-week high.

Earthgrains, the third-largest producer of fresh baked goods and the second largest producer of refrigerated dough in the United States, said it expects the stock split to increase liquidity of its shares and broaden the shareholder base.

Earthgrains said its board also approved an incentive compensation plan enabling senior managers to earn significant incentive payments if the company achieved certain performance goals within the next five years.
